purpose: Reference input rows for every Phase 17 real-data case. Figures live in oracle.json.
produced_by: realdata-p17-prep, from a headless scan of the private read-only library copy
identifiers: None. Night, target and rig are ordinals assigned in the sort order stated below; the filter keeps its own name, which names no place, person, rig or target. No path, no coordinate, no file name, no target name, no rig name, no camera name.
row_order: ORDER BY session_date, id, id compared ordinally as a string. Read straight from SQLite with its default BINARY collation on the id column; a Python sort of the same rows by (str(session_date), str(id)) produces the identical sequence.
id_spelling: uppercase hexadecimal with hyphens, 36 characters, for example XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX
export_order_index_note: export_order_index[i] is the index in `rows` of the i-th row in the exporter's own order (ORDER BY capture_date, id), which is the order every scenario without the _port_order suffix was computed in.
phd2_nights_note: Unrounded, exactly as phd2_night_subquery computes them (analysis.py 101 to 141), keyed by night and rig ordinal. 45 further (rig, night) pairs exist in the library on nights with no LIGHT frame; they join nothing and are not carried.
